state_queries.scheduled: SELECT count(*) FROM procrastinate_jobs WHERE status = 'todo' AND attempts = 0 AND scheduled_at > now()
state_queries.retryable: SELECT count(*) FROM procrastinate_jobs WHERE status = 'todo' AND attempts > 0
state_queries.dead: SELECT count(*) FROM procrastinate_jobs WHERE status = 'failed'
state_queries.running: SELECT count(*) FROM procrastinate_jobs WHERE status = 'doing'

operator_notes: JobManager.list_jobs_async(id=) and list_jobs_async(queue=, task='bench_alt', status='todo') (no LIMIT: returns every match), list_queues_async(queue=, status='todo') for the count; job args are not filterable, so handle and tenant lookups are unsupported; haystack via batch_defer_async into an unlistened queue; no pause API, so each replica stops its worker on pause and restarts it on resume
